_meta.comment: Hand-curated mirror of playbooks/roles/chocoDeploy/defaults/main.yml. When the role catalog changes, update this file too. The webui never executes ansible; it only assembles command strings.

step_descriptions.target: Which inventory file the play loads (-i) and the optional host or group pattern that narrows the run (-l). Either pick from the sidebar or type a path. The limit accepts a group name (basic_hosts), an exact hostname, or a wildcard pattern (test-host-01*).
step_descriptions.mode: How chocoDeploy decides what to touch. Conversion converts what is already there. Update is the fast Chocolatey-only pass. Baseline enforces the full catalog. Report only re-renders the daily HTML from existing JSON without changing software.
step_descriptions.apps: Controls the targetSoftware variable. Default uses the full managed catalog (apps flagged explicit-only are excluded). Filter runs only the apps you tick below. Skip skips the app pass entirely so the run is runtime-only.
step_descriptions.removals: Controls the removeSoftware variable. Default processes the full removal catalog. Filter removes only what you tick or what you list as ad-hoc package ids (any choco package id is accepted, not just catalog entries). Skip skips the removal pass entirely.
step_descriptions.runtimes: Runtime alignment is opt-in. Enable a runtime to add it to the run. Side-by-side runtimes (Python, modern .NET) use channel tracks; click a track chip to target it, or leave all unselected to auto-detect installed tracks based on the mode.
step_descriptions.flags: Reboot policy, force-replace orphan escape hatches (for vendor uninstallers that leave registry keys), Chocolatey behavior toggles, parallelism, tags, and a free-form -e box for anything not covered above.

modes.label: Conversion
modes.blurb: Convert detected vendor installs to Chocolatey ownership.
modes.details: Scans both the Chocolatey inventory and the Windows uninstall registry. Apps already present are upgraded to the approved version under Chocolatey management; vendor copies are removed in the process. No new applications are added. This is the routine alignment pass.

modes.label: Update (fast)
modes.blurb: Only Chocolatey-visible managed apps are checked.
modes.details: Skips the uninstall-registry probe entirely. Use as a recurring fast compliance pass when you only want to upgrade choco-managed apps in place. Never installs missing apps or sweeps vendor installs (unless floor_required is set on a runtime).

modes.label: Baseline (full)
modes.blurb: Enforce the full approved catalog on the host.
modes.details: Runs every managed app task. Installs missing apps, converts vendor installs where found, and upgrades existing managed software. Use for provisioning a new host or full remediation. Heaviest mode.

modes.label: Selective (named apps)
modes.blurb: Install/align ONLY the apps you explicitly name, on existing nodes.
modes.details: Processes exactly the apps in targetSoftware and nothing else: installs them if missing (clean host), converts vendor/manual installs, and upgrades choco-owned copies -- all in one pass. Requires a non-empty targetSoftware list; there is no full-catalog fallback, so it cannot accidentally push the whole catalog. Use to add or update one specific app across already-deployed hosts (e.g. azure-cli).

modes.label: Report only
modes.blurb: Re-render the daily HTML report from existing JSON files.
modes.details: Touches no software. Reads per-run JSON files from C:\tools\chocolog for the current UTC date and regenerates the consolidated daily HTML. Use to rebuild a report after deleting it, or after a template update.

apps_mode_options.label: Default catalog
apps_mode_options.desc: Omit targetSoftware. Runs the full managed catalog (apps marked explicit-only such as Teams are skipped).

apps_mode_options.label: Filter to selected apps below
apps_mode_options.desc: Emits targetSoftware:[...] containing only the apps you tick. Aliases (7zip, vscode, teams) resolve to canonical package ids.

apps_mode_options.label: Skip apps entirely (runtime-only run)
apps_mode_options.desc: Emits targetSoftware:[]. The app pass is skipped completely. Use this with a runtime selection for a runtime-only run.

rm_mode_options.label: Default catalog
rm_mode_options.desc: Omit removeSoftware. Processes the full removal catalog (currently Notepad++).

rm_mode_options.label: Filter to selected entries
rm_mode_options.desc: Emits removeSoftware:[...] with only the ticked entries plus any ad-hoc package ids you list below. Ad-hoc ids are removed by exact choco package name with no vendor-registry scan.

rm_mode_options.label: Skip removal entirely
rm_mode_options.desc: Emits removeSoftware:[]. The removal pass is skipped completely.

reboot_policies.label: never (default)
reboot_policies.desc: No reboot after the run. This is the safe default for prod hosts.

reboot_policies.label: if_needed (reboot only when pending)
reboot_policies.desc: Reboots only when a pending reboot was detected (.NET Framework upgrade, deferred MSI cleanup, etc.). Reboot is logged to the Application event log first.

reboot_policies.label: always (reboot every host)
reboot_policies.desc: Reboots every host at the end of a successful run regardless of pending-reboot state. Almost never what you want on a live fleet.

apps.label: Docker Desktop
apps.description: Docker Desktop. Has both Windows services and user-session tray/helper processes; pre-remove script stops services and uses taskkill /F /T to reach all sessions before uninstall.

apps.label: 7-Zip
apps.description: 7-Zip archive utility. Straightforward MSI; no special pre-remove handling required.

apps.label: Git
apps.description: Git for Windows. Routed to the internal repo when chocoInternalRepo includes it.

apps.label: Greenshot
apps.description: Greenshot screenshot tool (Inno Setup). Fragile: writes Publisher=Greenshot not Chocolatey, runs in user-session tray, and the Inno uninstaller can leave PendingFileRenameOperations. Supports greenshot_force_replace_orphan=true for stuck installs.

apps.label: Microsoft Teams (bootstrapper)
apps.description: Microsoft Teams machine-wide bootstrapper. The Teams client self-updates after provisioning. EXPLICIT-ONLY: skipped by the default catalog; you must add it to targetSoftware to manage it.

apps.label: PyCharm
apps.description: JetBrains PyCharm. Tagged install_size: large (45-minute Choco timeout, 50-minute task timeout). Pre-remove invokes JetBrains uninstaller with /S to dismiss the GUI.

apps.label: PuTTY
apps.description: PuTTY SSH/telnet client. Detect also matches putty.portable so vendor zip installs are caught.

apps.label: Vim
apps.description: Vim text editor. Pre-remove kills vim/gvim across all sessions to release file handles before uninstall.

apps.label: VS Code
apps.description: Visual Studio Code (system installer). Pre-remove runs only on a vendor-to-Chocolatey conversion; routine in-channel upgrades use state:latest with no kill.

apps.label: WinSCP
apps.description: WinSCP SFTP/SCP client (Inno Setup, like Greenshot). Supports winscp_install_force_replace_orphan=true when the uninstaller leaves the registry entry behind.

apps.label: Azure CLI
apps.description: Microsoft Azure CLI. Explicit-target only: excluded from the default catalog pass, so it is installed or upgraded only when ticked under Filter or named in targetSoftware.

apps.label: Java Runtime (JRE)
apps.description: Oracle Java Runtime Environment. Vendor detection matches 'Java N Update' and 'Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment' registry entries.

apps.label: NXLog CE
apps.description: NXLog CE log-forwarding agent. The choco package wraps the vendor MSI, so the uninstall registry entry reads NXLog-CE / NXLog Ltd rather than Chocolatey. On a removal run pass --skip-tags nxlog, otherwise nxlogConfig.yml re-deploys the config and restarts the service.

removal_catalog.label: Notepad++
removal_catalog.description: Notepad++ text editor. Catalog entry with alias + registry-pattern-based vendor detection. Removes choco package and vendor install registry entries.

removal_catalog.label: RealVNC
removal_catalog.description: RealVNC Viewer/Server. Blacklist entry: removed on every run where removeSoftware is unset. Detects the realvnc, vnc-viewer, and vnc-connect packages plus RealVNC/VNC Viewer/VNC Server registry entries.

runtimes.label: PowerShell Core
runtimes.description: PowerShell 7.x (pwsh). Single-track. FLEET DEFAULT (June 2026): min_version 7.6.0, floor_required=true in the role itself. Every targetRuntimes:[powershell_core] run brings the host to >= 7.6.x in any mode -- hosts with no pwsh get one installed; older versions upgraded in place. Known WinRM disconnect during the install is handled by the role's retry+verify path. Does not affect Windows PowerShell 5.1.

flags.label: Audit only (no changes)
flags.desc: Discovers and reports what would change but makes no changes. STRONGLY recommended for the first run on any inventory that has not been touched -- floor_required will install pwsh on hosts that have none.

flags.label: Remove vendor PowerShell installs (default ON)
flags.desc: Removes non-Chocolatey PowerShell 7-x64 installs detected in the uninstall registry. Default true in the role. Set false to keep vendor MSIs alongside the choco install.

runtimes.label: Python
runtimes.description: CPython. Side-by-side capable: each major.minor track lives in its own Chocolatey package (python312, python313, python314). FLEET DEFAULT (June 2026): floor_required=true is set in the role itself, so every targetRuntimes:[python] run enforces the 3.12 floor -- below-floor installs (3.10/3.11) are removed and 3.12 installed in their place; hosts with no python get 3.12 installed; sweep runs even in choco_update mode. Adding floor_required:true here is redundant but harmless. To OPT OUT for a single run, set floor_required:false in the runtime override.

flags.label: Remove vendor Python installs (matching aligned tracks)
flags.desc: After the choco install verifies, removes any non-Chocolatey python install for each aligned track from the uninstall registry. Off by default.

flags.label: Remove alias packages (python, python3)
flags.desc: Removes the generic 'python' and 'python3' meta-packages that pin to a moving track. Useful when migrating to explicit per-track packages.

flags.label: Audit only (no changes)
flags.desc: Discovers and reports what would change but makes no changes. STRONGLY recommended for the first python run on any inventory that has not been touched -- the new floor_required default will install 3.12 on every host that has no python.

runtimes.label: .NET Runtime (modern, side-by-side)
runtimes.description: Modern .NET (6+). Side-by-side capable; each major.minor track ships as dotnet-<track>-aspnetruntime. SDKs, Targeting Packs, Host components, and Hosting Bundles are never touched by alignment or sweep.

flags.label: Remove vendor .NET entries for aligned tracks
flags.desc: Removes vendor Runtime / ASP.NET Core / Windows Desktop Runtime entries from the uninstall registry whose major.minor matches an aligned track. Off by default.

flags.label: Audit only (no changes)
flags.desc: Discovers and reports what would change but makes no changes. Recommended for first runs of exclusive, floor_required, or cleanup_vendor.

runtimes.label: .NET Framework 4.8.1 (in-box; upgrade only)
runtimes.description: Legacy .NET Framework. Cannot be uninstalled, only upgraded in place. A reboot is required after a 4.8 -> 4.8.1 upgrade; the role records an advisory event and continues if the host already had a pending reboot.

flags.label: Audit only (no changes)
flags.desc: Discovers and reports what would change but makes no changes.

exclusive.label: exclusive (sweep tracks not in channels)
exclusive.desc: Enables the runtime sweep over channel mismatches. Out-of-policy tracks (both choco-managed and vendor) are removed. Recommend audit_only on the first run to preview removals.

floor_required.label: floor_required (always install floor + sweep below)
floor_required.desc: Always adds the floor track (min_supported_track) to the alignment list and runs the sweep even in choco_update mode. Designed for mixed-fleet onboarding: hosts with no runtime get the floor installed; hosts on older tracks have them removed.

min_supported_track.label: min_supported_track (e.g. 8.0)
min_supported_track.desc: Any installed track strictly less than this value is removed by the sweep regardless of exclusive mode. Set blank to disable the floor.

force_orphan_flags.label: greenshot_force_replace_orphan
force_orphan_flags.desc: When the Greenshot uninstaller fails to clean its Inno Setup registry key, nukes the canonical Greenshot_is1 key plus residual Program Files dir, then lets Chocolatey install on a clean slate. User config under %APPDATA% is preserved.

force_orphan_flags.label: winscp_install_force_replace_orphan
force_orphan_flags.desc: Same orphan-cleanup pattern as Greenshot, for WinSCP (also Inno Setup). Saved sessions and user config are preserved.

common_flags.label: choco_force_install=true
common_flags.desc: Force reinstall even when the same version is already present. Useful for troubleshooting a flaky install; adds overhead on every aligned package otherwise.

common_flags.label: choco_ignore_checksums=true
common_flags.desc: Bypass package integrity checks during install. Default. Set false only when all packages are served from a signed internal repository.

common_flags.label: choco_deploy_reset_daily=true
common_flags.desc: Delete today's JSON and HTML reports on the target host before writing the new run's report. Use after troubleshooting to clear accumulated bad data; the HTML report is rebuilt cleanly from the new run.

common_flags.label: choco_deploy_skip_pending_reboot=true
common_flags.desc: Hosts with a detected pending reboot skip the alignment pass and log an advisory. The host is added to the pending-reboot inventory file on the control node for a separate reboot pass.

field_help.inventory: Path to a YAML inventory under inventory/. Pick from the sidebar to set it automatically.
field_help.limit: Optional. Group name, hostname, or wildcard. Examples: basic_hosts | test-host-01.corp.example.com | fleet-host-04-*
field_help.app_filter: Each ticked app becomes an entry in targetSoftware. Override the per-app minimum approved version on the right (leave blank to use the catalog default).
field_help.rm_adhoc: Comma- or newline-separated choco package ids. Removed by exact name without vendor-registry scanning; useful for one-off cleanups or reversing a mistaken deployment.
field_help.tracks: Click chips to target specific tracks. Leave all unselected to let the role auto-detect installed tracks (choco only in update mode; choco + vendor in conversion; all configured channels in baseline).
field_help.forks: Override the default fork count from ansible.cfg (25). Increase for fleet-wide runs; decrease for noisy hosts or bandwidth-constrained sites.
field_help.tags: Comma-separated Ansible tags. e.g. choco_init for prep-only (bootstrap Chocolatey without alignment).
field_help.extra_raw: Anything not covered above. One -e per line. Use plain VAR=VALUE syntax (no quotes); the builder wraps each line in -e "...".
